name: SaaS on AWS pack
summary: A hosted web product with user accounts on AWS: front end, API, database and infrastructure as code.
fitsWhen: a web app other people sign up for and log in to

app.summary: Front end, API, database and the AWS infrastructure, deployed by code.

marketing-analyst.changes: Pricing tiers and competitor research for a subscription product.

ui-ux-designer.changes: Sign-up, login, settings and billing flows.

solution-architect.changes: Picks the AWS services, the tenant model and the infrastructure-as-code tool, each with an ADR.

data-storage-architect.changes: Tenant isolation in the data model, backups and data retention.

security-compliance-reviewer.changes: Adds authentication, least-privilege IAM, secrets handling and tenant isolation.

test-validator.changes: Adds integration tests against local stand-ins for AWS services.

cost-reviewer.plan: Estimates the monthly AWS cost of each infrastructure change from the infra diff and flags anything that grows with traffic.

it-analyst.changes: Installs the AWS CLI and the infrastructure tool; never stores credentials in the repo.

cloud-infra-engineer.plan: Writes the infrastructure as code and deploys to a test environment. Production deploys wait for the owner's go.

skillsToBuild.aws-well-architected-checklist: Short checklist from the AWS Well-Architected pillars that applies to a small team.
skillsToBuild.multi-tenant-security-checklist: Tenant isolation, auth flows, IAM least privilege, secrets, audit logging.
skillsToBuild.saas-aws-full-pipeline: Based on game/website-full-pipeline, with cloud-infra-engineer and cost-reviewer, and a production gate that needs the owner.
